body:
Integration seat (integration-90), 08:40 MST. aida-22 is no longer reachable, so this goes by mail.

1. Promotion 9b is PR #4040 (promote/integration-9b -> main), head 45c277dee61 = 80b64fc42f6 + one commit reverting merge 9d260e5f7e7 (#4003, BUG-2555): 7 files, +17/-204. Title trailer is (BUG-2563 BUG-2543 BUG-2551); BUG-2555 is only a "Refs" in the revert commit, so it is not completed. ci:full label is set. It merges cleanly with main f5128d18cf1. On that merge result dell1 passes 314 aida-cli-lib targeted tests and aida-core dispenser/work_binding/fs_atomic (54); in the files the revert touched the merge result is identical to main. I did not run the full suite. #4013 is untouched: close it when ready.

2. dell1 trap: in the integ-tip worktree every aida-core dispenser test fails with "this clone has no AIDA node binding yet"; the same commit passes in integ-b2569. Worktree state, not code; it started mattering after #3987. Worth adding to BUG-2582.

3. Integration: #4007 is merged and pushed, origin/integration = b7830c26182 (approved at 26a2f7666ac0, no hold, fast gate 48 passed).

4. #4022 round-2 fixes are pushed at a88e3f89cd: promotion-check asks a new gate function, gate/approval.rs merged_change_approval_authority (the gate-paths ratchet refuses authority code outside gate/); unknown [integration] keys and a non-table refused; a spec is unmarked only when no pending change names it; no marking without --push; origin-id traces. Fast gate 48 passed; dell1 1769 passed, only the known gate::mandate expiry_mail flake failed. Ready for re-review.

5. STORY-2768 S3a is NOT ready. Branch story-2768-s3a-housekeeping passes its tests and fast gate, but its live `aida land run --dry-run` did not finish in 10 minutes here. `aida land status` and `aida session hygiene --dry-run` alone each ran past 5 minutes with that binary (built before #4007; load average 13), so the cause may be the pull spin rather than the new step. I rebase it on integration and measure before opening a PR. It also makes derive never send a promote/* change to rework (it did; my sketch was wrong on that).

6. My queue: BUG-2555 fix on integration, S3a, BUG-2580, BUG-2583, BUG-2579. #4038 merges when approved at its head with no hold. #3950 I left for the dell1 lane.
subject: Promotion 9b is PR #4040; #4007 merged; #4022 ready for re-review; S3a not ready
